items.title: Large U.S. banks face rising G-SIB buffers and tighter excess capital: GS
items.summary: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs believes the largest U.S. banks are likely to moderate capital deployment as regulatory buffers rise for a third consecutive year and excess capital levels shrink.

items.summary: Elon Musk brought a staggering AI economic forecast to G20 policymakers, but Wall Street skeptics are raising pointed questions about the gap between today's debt-fueled buildout and the payoff Musk envisions.

items.title: Goldman Sachs favors equities over credit as late-cycle risks build
items.summary: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs remains overweight equities over a 12-month horizon while turning tactically more defensive, favoring stocks over credit as late-cycle risks mount, the investment bank told investors in a note Wednesday.

items.title: The Covered-Call Fund Nobody Talks About Pays a 70-Year-Old $2,900 a Month: GPIX
items.summary: Most retirees chasing monthly income from covered-call ETFs gravitate toward the same two or three names, but a Goldman Sachs fund quietly running an 8.6% yield tells a more complicated story about how much capital you actually need and what you give up to get it.
